checks.description: The completed criterion register has unique IDs matching the declared inventory; a WCAG 2.2 AA baseline retains all 55 A/AA required criteria.
Required-criterion counts and the two percentages match the four-state register and the visible report score table, with undefined denominators reported as not assessed.
Confirmed outcomes reference recorded evidence, failures link bidirectionally to findings with remediation and retest actions, and unknowns name a next check.
